audit_item: A08 Binance archive ingress, decode, and cache-size boundaries
finding: The optional instrument argument accepted empty or whitespace-padded strings. Those values could proceed past public ingress and fail only after archive fetch or event decoding. In addition, non-ASCII bytes in the downloaded .CHECKSUM response escaped as a raw UnicodeDecodeError instead of a contextual DataError. Invalid ZIP container bytes also leaked BadZipFile after the expected content hash passed. A pre-existing archive cache without a verified source receipt was also read fully before checking the importer size limit.

zip_container.input: synthetic non-ZIP bytes with matching SHA-256

preexisting_cache.input: synthetic cache larger than patched test size limit without source receipt
preexisting_cache.observed: fetch_archive read and accepted the cached bytes after SHA match

change.behavior: A supplied instrument must be a nonempty trimmed string; rejection occurs before output directory creation or fetch in both import_day and import_range. None continues to select the documented default instrument.
change.checksum_response: Non-ASCII checksum content now raises contextual DataError before checksum parsing.
change.zip_container: archive_events now normalizes malformed or unreadable ZIP container errors to contextual DataError while preserving existing DataError validations.
change.preexisting_cache: The shared archive size limit is applied to receipt-backed and unreceipted cache files; unreceipted cache size is checked from stat before read_bytes.

cases: non-ASCII remote checksum response becomes DataError
invalid ZIP container with matching content SHA becomes DataError
oversized preexisting cache rejected before read_bytes
regression.assertion: fetch is not called and output directory is not created

distribution.installed_provenance: 12/12 packages and 6/6 declared entry points resolve from RouteB app venv wheels

static_checks.mypy: passed for changed source and test files
static_checks.git_diff_check: passed; Git emitted only configured LF-to-CRLF notice

scope: Synthetic inputs only. No archive network request, market history, account, ledger, Validation, Test, or Holdout payload was accessed.
